name: npm-audit-runtime-disposition
reason: Template only. Do not rename to npm-audit-disposition.json unless release authority approves the residual Expo runtime audit findings or a clean audit cannot be achieved before the release window.
release_readiness_effect: No effect while this file remains npm-audit-disposition.template.json. The mobile-test verifier only evaluates npm-audit-disposition.json, and an approved disposition must remove template_only, use real non-placeholder authority values, remain unexpired, and match the retained audit evidence summary.

verifier_contract.approved_disposition_required_when: mobile/.appfw-mobile/npm-audit-evidence.json is retained and npm audit has not passed cleanly
release_grade_requires: clean registry-backed npm audit evidence, or
a non-template npm-audit-disposition.json approved by release/security authority, unexpired, and matching the retained audit summary

known_local_findings.posture: Expo SDK 57 runtime tree reports moderate npm audit findings; npm suggested fixes would downgrade Expo and are not compatible with the ratified React Native + Expo target.

uuid@7.0.3 is pulled by Expo config plugins through xcode@3.0.1; patched uuid versions are not available in the local npm cache, so this requires a controlled registry-backed upgrade or formal release disposition.

required_before_use: Verify current npm audit output from an approved network or internal registry path.
Confirm no safe Expo-compatible dependency upgrade clears the runtime audit findings.
Create npm-audit-disposition.json from this template only when keeping the app release-blocked is not the selected release decision.
Remove template_only or set it to false in the approved disposition file.
Replace approved_by and expires_on with real release authority values.
Replace reason with the release-specific acceptance or mitigation rationale.
Set release_approved to true only after release/security approval.
